desc: Derive/confirm the cost formula `sum(prefix_max - nums[i])`, its monotonicity in both endpoints, and the reversal-to-suffix-max argument justifying two pointers.
Implement the reversed-array sliding window with a deque of `[value, count]` groups; produce final `class Solution` code.
Write an O(n^2) brute-force reference and randomized stress test against the fast solution (300 random cases passed).
Check edge cases/performance: n=1, monotone inputs, large k, amortized O(n) with `deque` (no `list.pop(0)`).
